'''Frog's eye salad''' is a [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]] common in the American midwest.

==Ingredients==

*1 package Acini di pepe [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]]
*2 cans (30–40 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) crushed [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]]
*2 cans (30–40 oz) [[Cookbook:Mandarin orange|mandarin oranges]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Egg yolk|egg yolks]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 tub [[Cookbook:Imitation Whipped Topping|imitation whipped topping]]
*½ package miniature [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallows]]

==Procedure==
#Cook pasta in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Drain and rinse pasta.
#Drain cans of pineapple and oranges, reserving juice. 
#Mix juices, sugar and egg yolks in a medium [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Bring to full rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], stirring frequently until thickened. 
#Pour hot sauce over pasta. Cool and refrigerate overnight.
#Add fruit and mix well, then [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in whipped topping and marshmallows.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Keep refrigerated.
*Lasts for several days.
*Garnish with [[Cookbook:Maraschino Cherry|Maraschino cherries]].
*You may optionally add ½ cup flaked [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] or chopped [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|nuts]] ([[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]], [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], etc.)
